Following the reproduction steps above, this occurs on both `v4.6.dev4.official` and current master (ef34c3d534a16b140aef0643ed2fa36f8e9d1612)

MacOS `Version 15.6.1 (24G90)`.

Bisecting suggests the bug first appeared... in the commit that introduced this feature.

That was a good use of time 😅  

